rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MCP server implementation that provides AI assistants with comprehensive access to Wiki.js instances through GraphQL API integration, supporting both HTTP and stdio transports with Docker containerization. The implementation features full CRUD operations for wiki pages including search, retrieval by path or ID, creation, updating, deletion, and moving, plus page tree navigation and tag management, all with proper authentication via API keys and fallback mechanisms for GraphQL compatibility issues. Built with Python using FastMCP and httpx with extensive test coverage, it serves teams who need AI-powered wiki content management, documentation workflows, and knowledge base integration with robust error handling and production-ready deployment options through Docker Compose.
